title: On coKähler structures on Lie algebras
summary: We study coKähler structures on real Lie algebras by using the Fino-Vezzoni correspondence, which relates them to Kähler Lie algebras endowed with compatible skew-symmetric derivations. Our first result completes the flat case: every odd-dimensional flat Lie algebra admits a coKähler structure, giving a converse to the theorem of Fino and Vezzoni asserting that unimodular coKähler Lie algebras are flat and hence solvable.
